text:
Hi Sarah — I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. Looking at my week, the slots I have free are:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30
- Wednesday 13:00-13:30

Would one of those work for you? If you have a preferred length (say 30 or 60 minutes), tell me and I'll fit it in.

Hello — Professor Alvarez here. I'm arranging the CSE455 staff meeting for next week and would like to know two things: whether there is a room free for it, and whether there is anything on the official schedule next week that CSE455 staff should be aware of. My open slots are Monday 10:00-10:30, Tuesday 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30, Wednesday 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30.

Hello, Professor Alvarez. I can't help with rooms — I have no room-booking information, only the official schedule.

On the official schedule for next week, your slots look like this:
- Mon 10:00-10:30 — free (curriculum committee ends 10:00).
- Tue 11:00-11:30 — overlaps the seminar (Tue 09:50-11:10) until 11:10.
- Tue 15:00-15:30 — free (CSE452 lecture ends 15:00; CSE455 office hours start 15:30).
- Wed 10:00-10:30 — free (CSE455 office hours start 10:30).
- Wed 13:00-13:30 — free (CSE455 quiz section starts 13:30).

CSE455 items on next week's official schedule: Mon 14:30-15:20 lecture, Mon 16:30-17:00 office hours; Tue 09:00-10:30 lecture, Tue 12:20-13:30 office hours, Tue 15:30-16:20 office hours, Tue 16:20-17:00 quiz section; Wed 10:30-12:00 office hours, Wed 13:30-14:20 quiz section; Fri 13:20-14:30 lecture, Fri 15:20-17:00 office hours. Nothing on the schedule has been cancelled or moved.
Thank you — that's helpful. Noted: Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is out because of the seminar.
Noted. The other four slots you listed are clear on the official schedule.

Hi Professor Alvarez — thanks for the slots. I checked my week:

- Monday 10:00-10:30: I'm busy (CSE452 lab focus until 11:00)
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30: overlaps my lunch block (11:10-12:10)
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30: free ✔
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30: free ✔
- Wednesday 13:00-13:30: free ✔

My preference is **Wednesday 10:00-10:30** — I have it right before my CSE455 office hours (10:30-12:00), so a 30-minute meeting there works well. I've provisionally booked it on my side; say the word if you'd rather take Tuesday 15:00-15:30 or Wednesday 13:00-13:30 instead and I'll move it.

30 minutes is my preferred length. Shall I leave Wednesday 10:00-10:30 confirmed?
Wednesday 10:00-10:30 it is — confirmed on my side too, 30 minutes. I've put it in my calendar as the CSE455 staff meeting with you. Thanks, Sarah.
Great — Wednesday 10:00-10:30 it is, confirmed on my side too. I'll see you then. If anything changes on your end, just let me know and I'll reschedule.
Perfect. See you Wednesday at 10:00. I'll let you know if anything shifts.
